app.tagline: Prepare for the ISTQB Foundation Level exam

home.heroTitle: A free mock exam for ISTQB Foundation Level
home.heroLead: {{questions}} original questions written from the v{{version}} syllabus. Every option carries a reason — the right one and the wrong ones — in Turkish and in English. No account, no fee, and nothing you do here leaves your device.
home.blueprintCaption: {{total}} questions spread across {{chapters}} chapters in the proportions ISTQB publishes. Each one is worth a single point.
home.modesLead: Study builds the ground, practice drills it, the mock exam measures it. You can start anywhere.
home.startHereBody: If this is your first visit, start with study: it takes the {{total}} learning objectives one at a time, each with a card to read and questions drawn only from that objective. If you already know the material, sit a mock exam first and find out where you stand.
home.resumeTitle: You have a session in progress
home.coverage: {{questions}} original questions in the pool, covering {{covered}} of the {{total}} learning objectives.
home.poolWarningTitle: The pool cannot build a full exam yet
home.poolWarningBody: At most {{available}}/{{required}} questions can be assembled right now. The gaps are listed below.
home.studyLead: Take one learning objective at a time: read its card, then answer questions drawn only from that objective.
home.studyTime: No limit. Stop and come back whenever you like.
home.studyAnswers: Shown the moment you choose one, with the reason for every option.
home.studyScore: Tracked per objective, so you can see which ones you have learned. No pass or fail.
home.practiceLead: Pick a chapter or the whole syllabus, pick how many questions, and work through them.
home.practiceTime: No limit, and no clock on screen.
home.practiceAnswers: Your choice: straight after each question, or all at the end.
home.practiceScore: Out of the questions you picked, with a review of every one.
home.examLead: {{count}} questions drawn from all {{chapters}} chapters in the official proportions, against the clock.
home.examTime: {{minutes}} minutes, counting down. It submits itself when time runs out.
home.examAnswers: Hidden until you submit, exactly as in the real exam.
home.examScore: {{pass}} of {{total}} correct passes. Then a full review, question by question.
home.officialBody: ISTQB and the Turkish Testing Board publish four sample exams with answer keys, free. Their licence does not let anyone republish them, so you will not find them in this pool — but you will find where to download them.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.intro: {{count}} terms taken from the official syllabi's own per-chapter keyword lists, v{{version}}.
glossary.noDefinitions: These are translations, not definitions. No definition text from the ISTQB Glossary is copied here, because its licence has not been verified yet.

lists.title: My lists
lists.intro: These lists are derived from the answers you have already given. There is nothing to mark by hand.
lists.noSessions: You have not finished a session yet. Your lists appear here once you complete a practice set or an exam.
lists.wrongEmpty: Nothing you answered most recently was wrong.
lists.shakyTitle: Never right twice in a row
lists.shakyEmpty: Every question you have answered has been right twice in a row at least once.

repetition.title: Repetition
repetition.intro: Every question you answer wrong — in study, practice or the exam — comes back here, spaced so that it returns just before you would forget it. After each answer, rate how well you knew it: your rating decides when you see it next.
repetition.gradeTitle: How well did you know it?
repetition.gradeLead: Be honest — a lucky guess is not knowledge. The time under each button is when the question comes back.
repetition.gradeWrongLead: You answered incorrectly, so the question comes back soon.
repetition.saveFailed: Your rating could not be saved — your browser may be blocking storage. Try again.
repetition.emptyBody: When you answer a question wrong in study, practice or the exam, it is added here automatically.
repetition.reviewed_one: You repeated {{count}} question in this session.
repetition.reviewed_other: You repeated {{count}} questions in this session.
repetition.nextDue: The next one is due in {{interval}}.

myData.title: Your data
myData.intro: Your progress — sessions, answers, learned objectives and the repetition deck — is stored only in this browser, and nothing is sent anywhere. To keep it safe, or to carry it to another device, download a copy and load it there.
myData.exportBody: One JSON file holding everything this browser keeps for you. It goes only where you save it.
myData.exportFailed: The file could not be created — your browser may be blocking storage.
myData.importBody: Nothing on this device is deleted. Where the file and this browser hold the same record, the newer one is kept, so loading the same file twice changes nothing.
myData.preview: Saved on {{date}}. Sessions: {{sessions}} · answers: {{answers}} · objective records: {{objectives}} · repetition cards: {{cards}}.
myData.versionWarning: The questions have been updated since this file was saved. Your progress still loads — a question that has changed since shows its current text.
myData.imported: Loaded. New records: {{added}} · updated from the file: {{updated}} · kept from this browser because they were newer: {{kept}}.
myData.importFailed: The file could not be loaded into this browser — your browser may be blocking storage. Nothing was changed.
myData.errorNotJson: This file is not readable JSON. Choose the file this site downloaded for you.
myData.errorNotBackup: This is not a progress file from this site.
myData.errorNewerFormat: This file was made by a newer version of this site. Reload the page and try again.
myData.errorNewerSchema: This file was made by a newer version of this site. Reload the page and try again.
myData.errorInvalidRows: This file is damaged: some of its records are incomplete, so none of it was loaded.

sources.title: Sources and copyright
sources.disclaimer: This platform is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, nor endorsed by, ISTQB® or the Turkish Testing Board. The content is written from scratch against the official syllabus and does not reproduce exam questions. No guarantee is given regarding your exam result. For official and current information, see istqb.org and turkishtestingboard.org.
sources.officialExamsBody: ISTQB and the Turkish Testing Board publish four sample exams with their answer keys, free to download. Their questions are not reproduced here and never will be — the links below take you to the publisher, where you can answer them at the source.
sources.officialExamsNotice: Their copyright notice permits "extracts, for non-commercial use […] if the source is acknowledged", and states that "any other use of this sample exam is prohibited without first obtaining the approval in writing of the ISTQB®". Copyright © International Software Testing Qualifications Board.
sources.privacyBody: No account, no server, no analytics. All your progress is stored only in your own browser's IndexedDB and is never sent anywhere. Clearing your browser data also clears your progress.
